in_marathi.name: Bhrithi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhrithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhrithi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhru' meaning forehead and 'Thi' meaning Goddess. The name signifies the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge, often depicted as the goddess of learning and education. In Hindu mythology, Bhrithi is considered the goddess of wisdom, truth, and knowledge. She is believed to grant intelligence and understanding to those who seek her blessings.
